messages:
Taylor: FYI tenant T-88 saw a bunch of negative invoice adjustments today. Preview showed +1.2M tokens, final invoice shows ~0 tokens after adjustments. Appears to be aggregation/dedupe mismatch.

Diego: Trace summary: edge proxy deployed adaptive-batching last week. It coalesces small client requests into one metering envelope. Billing finalizer expects one envelope per original request and relies on request_id+client_seq for deterministic expansion. Some proxies drop client_seq.

Rina: Symptom: preview service counts tokens per incoming envelope. Billing normalizer expands `original_requests` and reconstructs per-request lines. If expansion fails we mark for manual adjustment and emit negative correction lines.

Sam: Any SDK versions tied to this?

Diego: SDK v2.4.0+ sets `x-adaptive-batch:1` and includes `original_requests` array. Older proxies strip `client_seq`. Without it finalizer can't expand reliably.

Billing: We logged ~430 adjustments overnight, net impact ~-$760. Low but customer-visible.

Taylor: Example envelope (sanitized):
```json
{
  \"tenant_id\": \"T-88\",
  \"envelope_id\": \"env-2024-06-30-0001\",
  \"tokens\": 1200,
  \"original_requests\": [{\"request_id\":\"r-A1\",\"tokens\":300},{\"request_id\":\"r-B2\",\"tokens\":400}],
  \"headers\": {\"x-adaptive-batch\":\"1\"}
}
```

Rina: Current behavior: if `client_seq` missing, expansion does best-effort split then flag envelope for -tokens adjustment to prevent duplicates. That's generating the negative lines.

Sam: Short-term mitigation?

Diego: Rollback adaptive-batching for metering traffic only. Gate batching by header `x-metering-safe` and default to off. I can push proxy config to canary.

OncallBot: PAGE-3745 created and oncall paged.

UI Bot: Draft console banner: "Investigating invoice preview differences for some customers related to a batching rollout. Final invoices are being reconciled." Approve?

Billing: Approve, add status link.

Rina: Medium-term fixes: deterministic expansion fallback (stable sort on request_id), integration tests for malformed `original_requests`, telemetry for percent missing `client_seq`, alert when preview vs final >7% for tenants >$200/mo.

Sam: I can implement deterministic expansion and add a backfill job to reprocess flagged envelopes for 48h. Dry-run first.

Diego: I'll revert batching on canary hosts and coordinate SDK owners to require proxy >=X for batching.

Taylor: Backfill cost/ETA?

Sam: 48h window ~3 CPU-hours and 1.1TB IO per region. Dry-run ~45m. Will add safety switch to abort if delta >10%.

Diego: Suggest manual review cutoff: if expansion changes >2% of tenant monthly tokens, escalate to manual queue.

Billing: Strong +1 for manual review threshold.

Taylor: Action items: Diego revert batching for metering canary; Sam PR for expansion + backfill; Rina add tests + telemetry; UI Bot post banner; Billing draft customer note if manual reviews needed.

Sam: Opening PRs and job spec, tagging @Diego and @Rina.

Taylor: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups in #incidents. :thumbsup:
